title: Cyclosiloxane sandwich complexes of a lanthanide metal: Na6{[(C6H5SiO2)8]2Nd4(μ4-O)}

material_class.structural_family: cyclosiloxanolate sandwich cluster with planar Nd4(μ4-O) core

synthesis.procedure: In a 1 L four-neck flask equipped with a KPG stirrer, reflux condenser and thermometer, polyphenylsiloxane (4.85 g, 0.0376 mol “PhSiO”), sodium hydroxide (0.84 g, 0.021 mol) and 120 mL of n-butanol were charged. The mixture was stirred and refluxed (oil bath) for 1.5 h, then cooled to 50–60 °C, and sodium metal (2.37 g, 0.0094 mol, cut into small pieces) was added. The mixture was again brought to reflux and stirred for 1 h. Anhydrous NdCl3 (2.73 g, 0.094 mol) dissolved in 150 mL of n-butanol was added dropwise to the refluxing mixture through the condenser, and reflux was continued for 1 h. After cooling to room temperature the mixture was filtered to remove NaCl, and n-BuOH was removed under reduced pressure. The resulting white mass was recrystallized from toluene–96% EtOH (2:1) to give a white crystalline product (1.31 g, 15.6%). Freshly prepared crystals used for X-ray diffraction corresponded to the 10 EtOH / 8 H2O solvate; other recrystallization/storage conditions gave related solvates of the same cluster unit (n = 3–10 EtOH, m = 8–20 H2O).
synthesis.temperature: reflux in n-butanol; sodium addition at 50–60 °C; cool to room temperature before filtration
synthesis.time: 1.5 h reflux (siloxane/NaOH); 1 h reflux after Na addition; 1 h reflux after NdCl3 addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 1 L four-neck flask with KPG stirrer, reflux condenser and thermometer; oil-bath reflux; filtration; reduced-pressure removal of n-BuOH
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter to remove NaCl; evaporate n-BuOH under reduced pressure; recrystallize the white residue from toluene–96% EtOH (2:1).

properties.summary: Room-temperature Gouy-balance magnetic susceptibility of the n = 10, m = 8 solvate gives χM^C = 17842.7 × 10^−6 cgs units mol^−1 and μeff = 6.42 BM, described as a preliminary measurement consistent with four Nd3+ centres.

measurements.name: corrected molar magnetic susceptibility χM^C
measurements.conditions: solvate n = 10, m = 8; Gouy balance; room temperature; diamagnetic corrections per Landolt–Börnstein Ref. [18]
